Permanent evidence: ONE generalized invariant 'offered => acceptable, held => not offered' across every bundled language-choice producer (Human, Half-Elf, High Elf; each with ordinary and custom Acolyte) with canonical and variant spellings, plus ONE CLI test: cross-group duplicate refused without losing earlier picks, resumed variant-spelling draft marked correctly, distinct pick completes. Re-check the review's dismissed 'no requirement' items stay untouched. SRD fidelity: rule:languages p.59, High Elf, Acolyte, Customizing a Background. Report in notes the full 50-row table with each defect row's resolution. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes; close this bead. No push/PR.
